description.ko: 육군 전산 자산과 무기체계의 취약점을 분석하고 개선 방안을 도출했습니다. 사이버·전자전 분야의 연구 과제를 수행하고 관련 소요를 제기했습니다. 또한 군이 보유한 사이버 자산을 보다 효과적으로 활용하는 방안을 제안하고 실증했습니다.
description.en: I assessed vulnerabilities in Army IT assets and weapon systems and developed recommendations for improvement. I conducted research in cyber and electronic warfare and submitted capability requirement proposals. I also proposed and demonstrated ways to make more effective use of existing military cyber assets.

description.en: Served two terms as academic division chair. Work included collecting clubs' opinions, drafting bylaw amendments, mediating disputes, and reviewing activity reports.

description.en: Worked as a teaching assistant and taught C++ and Olympiad preparation classes.
